aoci_overview.scope: Optional cognition scope: all, project, meta, code, or database; Volumes v1 defaults to all and Legacy no-argument behavior is unchanged
aoci_overview.cognition_state_version: Optional additive cognition-state projection version; use cognition-state/v2 to request independent delivery, model-usability, strict-Attestation, governance, and current-system reliability fields; omit it for the exact legacy response shape
aoci_overview.cognition_receipt: Optional receipt from a previous complete delivery or checkpoint
aoci_overview.model_cognition_state: Host assessment of current complete cognition: valid, uncertain, or invalid
aoci_overview.scope_covered: Whether the current task remains within the cognition scope already established
aoci_overview.check_only: Return only the compact checkpoint assessment; when false or absent, deliver the complete requested scope if a coherent snapshot is available
aoci_overview.refresh_reasons: Optional host-declared refresh reasons: context_compaction and/or phase_transition; semantic_threshold is machine-derived
aoci_overview.refresh_event_id: Host event idempotency key required when refresh_reasons are declared
aoci_overview.stable_checkpoint: Whether current edits, formatting, lint, and required tests have reached the nearest stable checkpoint
aoci_overview.host_delivery_confirmation: Host-observed body byte count, SHA-256, and end-marker confirmation
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation: One semantic model report and deterministic distributed challenge submission bound to the complete Overview; only one schema-only correction is allowed
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation.index_sha256: Exact current Index or requested-scope SHA-256 published with this Challenge; stale Attestation identities fail
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation.entry_sequen: Exact SHA-256 of the current ordered formal Entry or cognition-object sequence published with this Challenge
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation.entry_count: Exact current formal Entry count published with this Challenge, separate from the model-reported coverage count
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation.system_maste: Self-assessed mastery of the system framework: architecture, module responsibilities, strong relationships, stable external contracts, and high-entropy safety and maintenance constraints; not complete source, branch, identifier, test, or runtime knowledge
aoci_overview.model_cognition_attestation.challenge_an: 1-based position in the formal Entry sequence; Header, comments, blank lines, Section/Overview/Chunk markers, receipts, and Metadata are excluded, and Chunk Receipts use the same sequence
Exact canonical object identity, or for a Code object only its exact repository-relative path; no cleaning, case folding, basename lookup, or fuzzy resolution is accepted
aoci_overview.cursor: Exact deterministic Overview continuation cursor returned by the preceding chunk

aoci_get_entries.paths: Repository-relative paths of Entries to read (mutually exclusive with dir)
aoci_get_entries.dir: Repository-relative directory whose full Entry section should be read (mutually exclusive with paths)
aoci_get_entries.volume_id: Volumes v1 object Volume: code or database; omitted Legacy paths remain compatible
aoci_get_entries.object_refs: Canonical Volumes v1 object references; database tables use database://source/namespace/table identity

aoci_search.keyword: Case-insensitive keyword matched against the complete Entry line (provide this or tag_filter)
aoci_search.tag_filter: Tag filter such as A=Index or C>=7 (provide this or keyword)
aoci_search.scope: Optional Volumes v1 search scope: all, project, meta, code, or database

aoci_update_entry.path: Repository-relative target path for compatibility single-Entry mode
aoci_update_entry.object_ref: Canonical Database object identity for compatibility single-Entry mode
aoci_update_entry.new_entry: Complete single-line Entry for compatibility single-Entry mode
aoci_update_entry.source_sha256: Compatibility binding for Code source bytes or an existing Database object update; Database Cognition authoring uses candidate_id and batch_id instead
aoci_update_entry.candidate_id: Machine-owned Code or Database Cognition candidate identity returned by aoci_maintain; do not synthesize it or copy Evidence hashes into it
aoci_update_entry.batch_id: Machine-owned complete current Database Cognition batch identity returned by aoci_maintain
aoci_update_entry.code_batch_id: Machine-owned complete current Code Cognition batch identity returned by aoci_maintain
aoci_update_entry.entries: Submit the complete candidate set for the current machine-issued batch; continue through Maintain when remaining is nonzero
aoci_update_entry.entries[].path: Repository-relative path of the target file
aoci_update_entry.entries[].object_ref: Canonical Database object identity; use this instead of path for a table Entry
aoci_update_entry.entries[].new_entry: Complete single-line Entry: filename[tag]: F:... | R:... | A:... | S:...
aoci_update_entry.entries[].source_sha256: Source binding for a Code candidate; preserve it unchanged for a machine-issued Code batch
aoci_update_entry.entries[].candidate_id: Machine-owned identity for a Code or Database candidate; the complete current batch also requires its domain batch identity

aoci_maintain.scope: Optional advanced diagnostic scope. Omit it for ordinary Volumes v1 maintenance so AOCI automatically selects Code, Database, both, aligned, evidence_required, or blocked; explicit code, database, and all remain compatible

aoci_report.path: Repository-relative path related to the follow-up
aoci_report.note: Follow-up note describing what changed and why the Entry cannot yet be updated reliably

aoci_remove_entry.path: Explicit orphan identity: a Legacy repository-relative path, code:<path>, or canonical database:// object_ref returned by governance
